title: Sanctions & Watchlist Screener
description: Screen names against official sanctions lists.

names.title: Names
names.description: People or organisations to screen, one per line.

queries.title: Detailed queries
queries.description: Optional: [{"name": "Ali Khamenei", "id": "cust-42", "country": "IR", "dateOfBirth": "1939-04-19", "entityType": "individual"}]. country = ISO-2 or name; dateOfBirth = YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: Which official lists to screen against. Default: all five.

minScore.title: Minimum match score (0-100)
minScore.description: Fuzzy name score threshold. 85 balances recall and noise; use 90+ for fewer false positives, 80 for more recall.

maxMatchesPerName.title: Max matches per name
maxMatchesPerName.description: Top matches returned per name (match_count still reports the total).

entityType.title: Entity type
entityType.description: Default for all names; a query's own entityType wins.

country.title: Country (default for all names)
country.description: ISO-2 code or country name. Adds country_match to each match; see excludeNonMatchingCountry.

excludeNonMatchingCountry.title: Drop matches with a different country
excludeNonMatchingCountry.description: If on, matches whose listed countries do not include the query country are removed (entries without country data are kept).

dobYearTolerance.title: Date-of-birth year tolerance
dobYearTolerance.description: When a query has dateOfBirth, listed individuals whose birth years differ by more than this are dropped (entries without DOB are kept).

listDownloadTimeoutSecs.title: List download timeout (s)
listDownloadTimeoutSecs.description: Per list file. A list that cannot be downloaded is reported in lists_unavailable; the others are still screened.
